tactics: induction t <;> constructor <;> (try assumption) <;> (try exact F _ _ _ ‹_›)

induction t with
  | slnil => exact List.Sublist.below.slnil
  | cons a h ih => exact List.Sublist.below.cons a h ih (F _ _ h ih)
  | cons₂ a h ih => exact List.Sublist.below.cons₂ a h ih (F _ _ h ih)
induction t <;> simp_all [List.Sublist.below] <;> constructor <;> (try assumption) <;> (try exact F _ _ _ ‹_›)
